seo_title: Sunwise: Framer Template Design | The Brandle
summary: A light, editorial Framer template for marketing studios, with a hero where the sun rises on every visit.

brief.label: Framer template, marketing studios
brief.heading: The idea
paras: Most agency templates shout. Sunwise is calm, bright and clear about what you sell.
It is a light, editorial Framer template for marketing studios and agencies: white cards on soft mist, grainy sunrise art, and headlines with an italic accent.

answer.label: Launched 2026
answer.heading: What's inside
paras: The hero headline arrives word by word while the sun rises behind it, then sets again as you scroll. All of the motion is made with Framer's own effects. No code, so nothing for a buyer to break.
Nine pages and five CMS collections: case studies, insights, team, testimonials and FAQ. Case study and article pages build themselves from those.
It is on the Framer Marketplace. A template for people who sell attention, made by people who would quite like some.
